== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The early overlay preserves the underlying Decipher Vicious Howl 3. The remastered slip prints Vicious Howl 4. Both retain the 3-plus-destiny ferocity, Hoth habitat, marker deployment and the opposing player’s eat-or-relocate choice.
